name: P4-B validation / final-training policy screen (bounded, paired, 5-session cadence)
status: FROZEN before any P4-B fit; not launched
label: BURNED METHODOLOGY DIAGNOSTIC - selects a training methodology on the burned 2026-H1 interval; NOT independent OOS validation; all absolute numbers remain SURVIVOR-UNIVERSE / UNADJUSTED-PRICE references
question: Does the CURRENT validation policy (newest ~10% of matured dates held out, early stop on its IC, no refit on train+val) select worse models than a recent, shorter validation block, or than calibrating the epoch count and then training on train+validation?

held_constant.cadence: 5-session full refit (27 refits over the interval) - fixed for ALL policies; P0 showed 5-session ~= daily at the portfolio level
held_constant.early_stop_rule_where_used: argmax val rank IC, patience 3, min 2, max 25
held_constant.execution: T+1 close -> T+21 close label convention (next-open validated)

A_current.definition: matured_train_val: validation = newest 10% of matured dates (~260 sessions, contiguous, ending 21 sessions before the refit); train = all older matured dates ending 21 sessions before validation; early stop on validation IC; final weights = best-validation epoch; NO refit on train+val
A_current.fits: REUSED from P0 arm B cache (identical function, seeds, dates, config hash) - 0 new fits

B_recent126.definition: validation = the most recent 126 matured sessions (contiguous, ending 21 sessions before the refit); train = all matured dates ending 21 sessions before the validation block; early stop on validation IC; final = best-validation epoch; no refit on train+val

C_recent63.definition: as B with a 63-session validation block

D_calibrate_then_train_all.definition: step 1 = policy B's fit (reused): E = 1 + index of the best-validation epoch. step 2 = retrain the SAME seed from scratch on TRAIN + VALIDATION (policy B's blocks, i.e. every matured date up to 21 sessions before the refit) for EXACTLY E optimizer epochs and keep the weights after epoch E: no early stopping, no best-checkpoint restore. EXACT research-only mechanism (fit_fixed_epochs): production fit_one is called unchanged with patience=1e9, min_epochs=max_epochs=E and a 4-row sentinel validation slice taken from the training rows themselves; _rank_ic skips groups with < 5 rows, so no finite validation IC is ever observed, best_state stays None and no restore occurs (asserted: epochs_run == E and best_val_ic == -1e9). Same seed => identical initialization and batch permutation as the production path (tests/test_p4_epoch_diagnostic.py). No information after the refit date is used at any step.

epoch_diagnostic_P4_B0.definition: on 9 evenly spaced refit dates x 3 seeds under policy A's split, train with early stopping DISABLED for 15 epochs and, after every epoch, score (a) validation IC, (b) train loss, (c) the refit's 5-session OOS block IC (research-only; never used for selection). Implemented by wrapping predict_idx inside the research process only - production code untouched. Reports: per-epoch curves, correlation(val IC, later OOS IC) across epochs, regret = OOS IC at the validation-best epoch minus OOS IC at the ex-post best epoch, and OOS IC at a fixed epoch near the median early-stop point (6)
epoch_diagnostic_P4_B0.fits: 27 fits x 15 epochs (~2.5x a normal fit)

primary: Spearman(val IC, subsequent block OOS IC) across refits, raw and time-detrended
metrics.paired: all per-date metrics differenced against policy A on identical dates; HAC(20) SE

decision_thresholds.PROMISING (a policy may proceed to a 7-s: vs A on the same dates: dIC >= +0.005 AND dIC > +1 HAC SE AND positive-IC frequency >= A - 2pp AND spread >= A - 0.2pp AND val->OOS Spearman (time-detrended) >= A's + 0.30 or >= 0 AND d turnover <= +0.05 AND d max_dd <= +1.0pp AND all three seeds individually dIC >= 0
decision_thresholds.NOT_PROMISING: dIC <= -0.005 or fails two or more of the secondary/portfolio checks
decision_thresholds.VALIDATION_POLICY_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else; no winner is selected
decision_thresholds.note: thresholds frozen before the run; a +0.001 IC difference is noise; Sharpe-like metrics never decisive

compute.estimated_gpu_hours: B/C/D 243 x 52.9 s = 3.6 h; epoch diagnostic 27 x ~130 s = 1.0 h; total ~4.6 h (~5.5 h at the p90 70 s/fit)
compute.schedule_rule: start only after tonight's daily_ops has completed and the GPU is idle; must not overlap the next production window

P4_B0.purpose: Does validation-IC early stopping select better later-OOS epochs than a simple ex-ante fixed epoch? (primary diagnostic = WITHIN-refit epoch association, immune to the cross-refit time trend)

historical_selected_epoch_distribution.source: 213 production seed-fits (reports/transformer_gpu/*_train_log.md) + 480 P0 research fits; best epoch = epochs_run - patience(3) unless capped

P4_B0.epoch_horizon_justification: 15 >= max observed selected epoch (9) + 6 epochs margin and >= p95 (6) + 9; covers the entire empirical selection distribution; production max_epochs is 25 but no fit has ever selected beyond 9
P4_B0.refit_selection: 9 evenly spaced 5-session refit block-starts across the burned 2026-H1 interval (numpy.linspace over the 27 refits, rounded) — deterministic, chosen before any epoch-level result
P4_B0.training: Policy-A (production) split per refit; early stopping DISABLED (patience 1e9, min_epochs = max_epochs = horizon); per epoch record train loss, validation IC, validation MSE, subsequent OOS block IC, OOS prediction std; the OOS numbers are computed in a research-only wrapper of predict_idx and never affect optimisation or checkpoint choice; the trained net is discarded
P4_B0.oos_block: the refit's own 5-session block [r0, r0+4] (r0 = refit_rank + 1) scored against fwd_20 = close(T+21)/close(T+1) - 1 from the cache; all labels matured (cache through 2026-09-11); identical for every epoch of a refit; training/validation labels end <= refit_rank (asserted)
P4_B0.primary_justification: 3 = median production-selected epoch (ex-ante, from the historical distribution)
comparisons: production-selected epoch (patience-3/min-2 rule simulated on the val curve)
metrics: within-refit Spearman/Pearson(val IC, OOS IC) across epochs (primary); aggregate over all epoch observations (secondary, trend-confounded)
OOS IC of val-best / prod-selected / fixed-k / oracle
paired prod-selected minus fixed-k with refit-clustered SE (fits of one refit share the OOS block)
selected-epoch distribution; frac val-best within 2 epochs of oracle

classification.EARLY_STOPPING_INFORMATIVE: paired (prod-selected - fixed 3) mean OOS IC >= +0.010 AND > 1 refit-clustered SE AND prod-selected beats fixed 3 on >= 60% of fits AND median within-refit Spearman >= +0.30
classification.EARLY_STOPPING_UNINFORMATIVE: paired (prod-selected - fixed 3) mean <= +0.003 AND median within-refit Spearman <= +0.10
classification.note: frozen before the run; the oracle is a reference only, never the comparator

P4_B0.compute: 27 fits x 15 epochs; ~9 s/epoch + per-epoch OOS scoring -> ~150 s/fit -> ~1.1 h

P4_B0_LONG.question: Does OOS predictive quality remain degraded after the early epoch peak, or is there a later recovery at much larger epoch counts (100+)? Training-DURATION diagnostic only; architecture, data, optimizer, LR, batch unchanged.
P4_B0_LONG.refit_selection: EARLY / MIDDLE / LATE = first, middle (index 4) and last of the nine pre-registered P4-B0 refit dates — chosen before any long-epoch result
P4_B0_LONG.training: production Policy-A split (train rows, validation rows, purge 21), early stopping DISABLED, exactly 100 epochs, NO best-validation restore; per epoch: train loss, validation MSE, validation rank IC, future OOS block rank IC (diagnostic only), prediction dispersion, mean/max gradient norm (research-only wrap of clip_grad_norm_), weight norm; validation and OOS predictions of EVERY epoch retained (per-epoch weights are not stored: 9 x 100 x 470 KB)
P4_B0_LONG.oos_block: the refit's own 5-session block scored against fwd_20 (matured); identical for every epoch; never influences optimisation
P4_B0_LONG.primary_metric: future OOS rank IC (mean over the 9 fits at each checkpoint)

classification.LONG_EPOCH_PROMISING: late_regime >= max(epoch-3, production-selected) + 0.010 AND late >= epoch-3 + 0.010 on >= 7 of 9 fits AND >= production-selected + 0.010 on >= 7 of 9 AND holds by seed (all 3) and by refit (all 3)
classification.LONG_EPOCH_NO_BENEFIT: OOS IC at 50, 75 and 100 are each <= early_regime - 0.020 AND the mean per-fit best OOS IC over epochs >= 30 is < early_regime - 0.010 (no consistent late recovery)
classification.rule: classification from OOS rank IC only, never from training loss; no new preferred epoch may be chosen from this set

P4_B0_LONG.compute: 9 fits x 100 epochs x ~6.9 s = ~1.7 h (plus per-epoch OOS scoring); run only when production is idle
